editions.name: HUWiki Forge (landingswiki)
editions.description: Editable bilingual Forge homepage, shared Plugin Library and Community, and a local-copy-friendly TiddlyWiki

home.headingEn: Keep your own copy of this page
home.descriptionDa: Tag denne indgang til Editions og biblioteker med dig som en lokal wiki.
home.descriptionEn: Keep this gateway to Editions and libraries as your own local wiki.
home.noteDa: Biblioteker og nye downloads kræver internet.
home.noteEn: Libraries and new downloads require internet access.

editions.name: HUPedia Edition
editions.description: HUPedia: readable editable WikiText, Danish/English infoboxes and article translations using TiddlyWiki's language

home.descriptionDa: Saml artikler, faktabokse og kilder i dit eget opslagsværk.
home.descriptionEn: Build your own reference library of articles, fact boxes and sources.
home.noteDa: Artikelvisning og sprog er stadig under afprøvning.
home.noteEn: Article display and language support are still being tested.

editions.name: HUWiki Tegne Edition (test)
editions.description: Offline Excalidraw drawing studio with editable SVG scenes, SitePublisher and bilingual UI; large self-contained file; browser test pending

home.descriptionDa: Tegn med Excalidraw, gem redigerbare scener og udgiv som HTML.
home.descriptionEn: Draw with Excalidraw, keep editable scenes and publish to HTML.
home.noteDa: Stor HTML-fil. Mac- og iPad-accept udestår.
home.noteEn: Large HTML file. Mac and iPad acceptance is pending.

editions.name: HUWiki Musik Edition (test)
editions.description: ABC notation and playback · six teaching packs · MuseScore/MusicXML batch import · site/PDF publishing

home.descriptionDa: Skriv noder med ABC, importer fra MuseScore og udforsk seks undervisningspakker.
home.descriptionEn: Write ABC notation, import from MuseScore and explore six teaching collections.
home.noteDa: Afspilning, MIDI og iPad kræver fortsat afprøvning.
home.noteEn: Playback, MIDI and iPad support still need testing.

editions.name: HUWiki HUPin Edition (test)
editions.description: Interactive pins on images and SVG; optional PasteUp and online map integrations. English UI migration pending / Klikbare billeder og SVG

home.descriptionDa: Sæt klikbare punkter på billeder og SVG og forbind dem med dine tekster.
home.descriptionEn: Add clickable hotspots to images and SVG and connect them to your notes.
home.noteDa: Engelsk brugerflade er endnu ikke færdig.
home.noteEn: The English interface is not yet complete.

editions.name: Demo Edition
editions.description: Minimal test af TiddlyWiki-plugin og før-boot-indlæsning.

home.descriptionDa: En lille wiki til at prøve Forge, redigering og lokal gemning.
home.descriptionEn: A small wiki for trying Forge, editing and local saving.

editions.name: HUWiki CutOut Edition (test)
editions.description: Dukker, nøglebilleder, scener og lokal eksport fra den oprindelige CutOut-motor.

home.descriptionDa: Byg dukker, animér med nøglebilleder og hent en selvstændig visningskopi.
home.descriptionEn: Build puppets, animate with keyframes and download a standalone viewing copy.
home.noteDa: Afgrænset offline-test. Fuld eksempelsamling, tegnebro, Slideshow og touchaccept udestår.
home.noteEn: Limited offline test. Full examples, drawing bridge, Slideshow and touch acceptance are pending.
